description: Sign-in, MFA, privileged access, and identity governance for the 43,000 workforce users on SYS-G1 (the College's 2,000 staff are not yet on it)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every hospital, Health Plan, and corporate system federates to SYS-G1; without sign-in, clinicians fall back to downtime workstations
source_evidence: EV-088 (Group identity director interview); EV-005 (SYS-G1 sign-in policy); EV-002 (workforce by division)
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system; downtime workstations with locally cached accounts
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every Hospital System and Health Plan process; the College joins in 2027

business_process: Wide-area network, site connectivity, and voice
description: Links from 9 hospitals, 46 outpatient sites, 64 community-connect practices, and the Health Plan and College sites to DC1 and DC2; hospital voice systems
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Hospitals cannot reach the EHR in DC1 without the WAN; voice outages stop EMS and transfer calls
source_evidence: EV-088 (Group network director interview); EV-017 (diverse carriers; analog lines and radios)
manual_workaround: Cellular failover at outpatient sites; analog lines and radios in every ED and command center
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All Hospital System sites; Health Plan claims core link; College administrative file access

business_process: Data center compute, storage, and virtualization
description: DC1 (primary) and DC2 (secondary) host the EHR, ancillary clinical systems, the Health Plan claims core, and the group file service

source_evidence: EV-088 (Group infrastructure director interview); EV-046 (contingency plan; DC2 failover); EV-021 (15-minute snapshots)

dependent_third_parties: Hardware and virtualization vendors; colocation provider for DC2
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-H1, SYS-H2, SYS-P1 claims core, College administrative file shares

description: Immutable backup copies of data center and cloud workloads at cloud provider B, and the restore process

dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider B; backup software vendor
